target: Case editor resilience beyond representative section roundtrips
requiredOracles: headed Firefox state for every authenticated actor

priorityTransitions.name: concurrent-scalar-edit
priorityTransitions.transition: two users read the same revision -> user A saves -> user B saves stale state
priorityTransitions.oracle: no silent loss outside the explicitly edited field; both outcomes and audit actors are exact

priorityTransitions.name: concurrent-edit-delete
priorityTransitions.transition: two users read the same repeatable row -> user A edits -> user B deletes stale row
priorityTransitions.oracle: terminal row state and audit order are deterministic; sibling rows remain unchanged

priorityTransitions.name: interrupted-write
priorityTransitions.transition: authenticated save -> transport or process interruption before response -> reread and bounded retry
priorityTransitions.oracle: one committed state and one audit mutation, or a clear failure with no mutation

priorityTransitions.name: ui-repeatable-create
priorityTransitions.transition: UI Add -> populate -> Save -> reload -> relogin -> UI delete
targets: DG substance, dosage, indication and assessment

priorityTransitions.name: authority-matrix
priorityTransitions.transition: FDA and MFDS regional control -> Save -> canonical readback -> reload

priorityTransitions.name: presave-selection-race
priorityTransitions.transition: select source -> mutate source -> save Case

adaptiveRules: classify stale-write acceptance separately from rejected conflicts
never infer failure from a lost browser response; read API, database and audit before retry
create verification rows through the rendered Add control when testing UI creation
preserve an owned sibling for every repeatable-row mutation
stop and recover before widening scope when a committed mutation has no terminal oracle
